label: Constitutional Amendment (Citizen Clarification)
what: Rewords the voter-qualification section of the Kansas Constitution to state that only a U.S. citizen can be a qualified elector. Federal and state law already require citizenship to vote.
y: The constitution would state explicitly that only U.S. citizens are eligible to vote.
n: The existing voter-qualification language stays unchanged.
pro: Rep. Pat Proctor, Kansas Republican Party, Americans for Citizen Voting, Opportunity Solutions Project
con: League of Women Voters of Kansas, ACLU of Kansas, Loud Light Civic Action
